extracted.name: Fried Buttered Noodles
extracted.description: Fried buttered noodles, using egg noodles, are quick and easy to prepare and are a great accompaniment to roast beef.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup bread crumbs, or to taste
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook egg noodles at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes; drain.

Melt butter in a skillet or large pot over low heat. Add bread crumbs and stir until coated in butter. Mix noodles into bread crumbs mixture. Cook, stirring occasionally, until a crust forms on the bottom, about 30 minutes; season with salt.
